purpose: Public timetable OCR regression: actual bundled Russian Tesseract model on Android; no fabricated clock values
repairCoverage: Only intervals between two explicitly printed consecutive day headings are imported. The final band has no proven closing boundary and is excluded; this fixture is not evidence of a fully imported week.
safetyRegressions: Supplementary cancellation survives failed later pass
Missing final date never transfers its clocks to the preceding date
Ordinary HH:mm conflicts are checked in every pass
